articles.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
articles.description: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
articles.description: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
articles.description: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Databricks’ new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
articles.description: At 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
articles.description: Like the end-to-end models trained to drive cars, AI agents are probabilistic systems operating in unpredictable environments.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
articles.description: The governance experts we talked to say nobody has seen anything like what's unfolding right now.
articles.author: Connie Loizos

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
articles.description: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
articles.description: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
articles.description: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
articles.description: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz
